note: Rules no fixture can cover, and why. Read by tests/run_tests.py and by `sqs.py rules --audit`, so the two never disagree about what is tested.

unit_covered.ST015: sqs.py builds its work list from folders that have a SKILL.md, so a folder without one never reaches it. The structure engine is called directly in tests/run_tests.py instead.
unit_covered.PB015: Needs a git checkout to know where the repository root is, and a fixture cannot carry a .git directory. tests/run_tests.py builds one in a temporary directory, both sides.

no_engine.ST016: The opt-in external-link check. The row documents a gap; nothing emits it yet.
